title: Service voucher
description: Terms a shop adds to a line item when the item is a voucher for a service: when and where it happens, whether it can be refunded, how it is redeemed and how many one person may buy. A deal is either for a set date or open-dated; an open-dated deal counts its deadlines in days from the purchase, and they become dates on the order. All times are ISO 8601 with an offset.

deal_id.description: The deal the bought option belongs to.

option.description: Line items only. The option bought, e.g. '60 minutes'.

window.description: When the service happens, not when it is bought. Absent for open-dated deals, which are booked after buying.

includes.description: Line items only. What the option bought includes.

refundable_until.description: Last moment a refund is due. On open-dated deals it only exists on the order.

refund_days.description: Open-dated deals: days after the purchase in which a refund is due.

expires_at.description: When the promotional value runs out. On open-dated deals it only exists on the order.

codes.description: Order only. One code per unit bought, shown at the venue to redeem.

valid_days.description: Open-dated deals: days after the purchase the promotional value lasts.

amount_paid_expires.description: Whether the amount paid is lost when the promotional value runs out. Always false.

booking_contact.description: Order only. How to reach the merchant to book.

limit_per_person.description: Most units one person may buy, across the deal's options.

repurchase_days.description: Days after which a person may buy again. Absent: never again.
